which sometimes occurred if he ran more than 2 miles
no family history of premature coronary artery disease
ST depressions occurred during recovery phase

concepts.why: The patient's symptoms of substernal chest pain, hypertension, high LDL, and ST depressions during the recovery phase of the exercise treadmill test, along with the CCTA results demonstrating 3-vessel involvement, support the diagnosis of coronary artery disease.

The patient's symptoms of chest pain during exertion, such as running more than 2 miles, and ST depressions during the recovery phase of the exercise treadmill test, support the diagnosis of stable angina.
The patient's history of hypertension, controlled with medication, and blood pressure of 134/80 mm Hg, support the diagnosis of hypertensive heart disease.
The patient's high LDL and low HDL levels support the diagnosis of hyperlipidemia.
The patient's ST depressions during the recovery phase of the exercise treadmill test and the PET-MPI results showing severe ischemia support the diagnosis of myocardial ischemia.
The patient's symptoms and test results, including the CCTA demonstrating 3-vessel involvement, support the diagnosis of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
The patient's symptoms and test results, including the CCTA and PET-MPI results, support the diagnosis of cardiovascular disease.

The patient's symptoms of chest pain and ST depressions during the recovery phase of the exercise treadmill test, along with the CCTA results demonstrating 3-vessel involvement, support the diagnosis of acute coronary syndrome.

rationales.F01: Substernal chest pain is a common symptom of coronary artery disease and myocardial ischemia.
rationales.F03: Chest pain triggered by physical activity is a characteristic feature of angina pectoris.
rationales.F04: Hypertension is a risk factor for coronary artery disease and hypertensive heart disease.
rationales.F05: Elevated LDL cholesterol is a risk factor for coronary artery disease and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
rationales.F06: High HDL cholesterol is protective against coronary artery disease and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
rationales.F11: ST depressions during the recovery phase of an exercise treadmill test are indicative of myocardial ischemia.
rationales.F12: Three-vessel involvement on a computed tomography angiogram is diagnostic of coronary artery disease.

frontier_selector.rationale: CCTA demonstrated 3-vessel involvement, PET-MPI showed severe ischemia, and coronary angiogram confirmed findings, which strongly support coronary artery disease as the primary diagnosis.
